svg.title: Checkout and the interfaces it relies on
svg.desc: Architecture diagram with 8 components and 7 connections in 1 boundary. Shop platform: Checkout, Support, Orders, Payments, Order store. Main path: Shopper → Web shop → Checkout → Payments → Card processor. Most connected: Checkout and Payments (3 connections each). Nothing leads into Shopper and Support. Nothing leads out of Order store and Card processor. Bottleneck: Checkout; without it the diagram falls apart. Shopper (person): connects to Web shop (buys). Web shop (frontend): connects to Checkout (submits, via HTTPS). Checkout (service): connects to Orders (requires Orders API, places) and Payments (requires Payments API, charges). Support (service): connects to Payments (requires Refunds API, refunds). Orders (service): connects to Order store (via SQL). Payments (service): connects to Card processor (via HTTPS). Order store (database): no outgoing connection. Card processor (external system): no outgoing connection. Orders provides Orders API. Payments provides Payments API and Refunds API.
